questions.text: Thanos's snap wipes out half of all life. If a town had 3,000 people, how many are left?
Four 'Strictly' judges each score out of 10. What is the highest possible total?
What is the next letter: M, T, W, T, F, S, ___?
questions.why: These are the initials of the days Monday to Saturday, so next is S for Sunday.
January, March, May, July, August, October and December have 31 days: that's 7.
The gaps go up by one each time (2, 3, 4, 5), so the next gap is 6: 18 + 6 = 24.

questions.text: How many letters are in THE ALPHABET?
questions.why: THE has 3 letters and ALPHABET has 8, so THE ALPHABET has 11.

questions.text: What is the missing letter: A, E, F, H, I, K, L, M, N, ___? (Think about how they are written.)
answers: T - letters made of straight lines only
questions.why: A, E, F, H, I, K, L, M and N are made only of straight lines; O, P, Q, R and S are curved, so next is T.

questions.text: A farmyard has only chickens and cows. There are 10 heads and 28 legs. How many cows are there?
questions.why: If all 10 were chickens there'd be 20 legs; each cow adds 2, and 8 extra legs means 4 cows (16 + 12 = 28).

questions.text: How many people must be in a room for it to be more likely than not that two share a birthday?
questions.why: With 23 people there are 253 possible pairs, which pushes the chance of a shared birthday just past 50% (50.7%).

questions.text: What is the only English word in everyday use that ends in the letters -MT?
questions.why: DREAMT (the past tense of dream) is the only common word that ends in -MT.

questions.text: How many different ways can you arrange the letters of the word LEVEL?
questions.why: LEVEL has 5 letters with L and E each appearing twice: 5! ÷ (2! × 2!) = 120 ÷ 4 = 30.
